guardrailIdentifier.title: Guardrail Identifier
guardrailIdentifier.description: The identifier (ID or ARN) for the guardrail to apply to the model invocation

guardrailTrace.title: Guardrail Trace
guardrailTrace.description: Whether to return trace information from the guardrail

guardrailVersion.title: Guardrail Version
guardrailVersion.description: The version of the guardrail to use. Defaults to DRAFT.

includeStreamingMetadata.title: Include Streaming Metadata
includeStreamingMetadata.description: Whether to include streaming metadata in the response headers (completion reason, token count, chunk count)

modelId.title: Model Id
modelId.description: Define the model Id we are going to use

overrideEndpoint.title: Override Endpoint
overrideEndpoint.description: Set the need for overriding the endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with the uriEndpointOverride option

pojoRequest.title: Pojo Request
pojoRequest.description: If we want to use a POJO request as body or not

profileCredentialsName.title: Profile Credentials Name
profileCredentialsName.description: If using a profile credentials provider, this parameter will set the profile name

region.title: Region
region.description: The region in which Bedrock client needs to work. When using this parameter, the configuration will expect the lowercase name of the region (for example, ap-east-1) You'll need to use the name Region.EU_WEST_1.id()

streamOutputMode.title: Stream Output Mode
streamOutputMode.description: The streaming output mode (complete or chunks). In complete mode, the full response is accumulated and returned as a single message. In chunks mode, each chunk is emitted as a separate exchange.

uriEndpointOverride.title: Uri Endpoint Override
uriEndpointOverride.description: Set the overriding uri endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with overrideEndpoint option

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.title: Use Default Credentials Provider
useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Set whether the Bedrock client should expect to load credentials through a default credentials provider or to expect static credentials to be passed in.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.title: Use Profile Credentials Provider
useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Set whether the Bedrock client should expect to load credentials through a profile credentials provider.

lazyStartProducer.title: Lazy Start Producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

bedrockRuntimeAsyncClient.title: Bedrock Runtime Async Client
bedrockRuntimeAsyncClient.description: To use an existing configured AWS Bedrock Runtime Async client for streaming operations

bedrockRuntimeClient.title: Bedrock Runtime Client
bedrockRuntimeClient.description: To use an existing configured AWS Bedrock Runtime client

proxyHost.title: Proxy Host
proxyHost.description: To define a proxy host when instantiating the Bedrock client

proxyPort.title: Proxy Port
proxyPort.description: To define a proxy port when instantiating the Bedrock client

proxyProtocol.title: Proxy Protocol
proxyProtocol.description: To define a proxy protocol when instantiating the Bedrock client

sessionToken.title: Session Token
sessionToken.description: Amazon AWS Session Token used when the user needs to assume an IAM role

trustAllCertificates.title: Trust All Certificates
trustAllCertificates.description: If we want to trust all certificates in case of overriding the endpoint

useSessionCredentials.title: Use Session Credentials
useSessionCredentials.description: Set whether the Bedrock client should expect to use Session Credentials. This is useful in a situation in which the user needs to assume an IAM role for doing operations in Bedrock.
